title: chart
intention: THE CHART DEVICE — extract, debug, and grow the question nexi of the pre-build preamble (orient, constrain, survey, decompose, triage, hypothesize, validate), knowing more nexi and more depth per nexus will be FOUND as we go (the roster is open by intention). Each nexus is a standalone typed unit: input + feedback + candidate core questions + domain-specific knowledge + core questions + output, WORKED by a mini agentic loop (think -> act -> observe until the LOCAL exit condition) that actively assembles the output — never a bare lookup. Each nexus is three strata tried in order: DETERMINISTIC FLOOR (ordinary code: parse, index, convention lookup, cache), TREE WALK (the nexus's graph tree — the same tools as the librarian's, whose agentic loop is a simpler form of CC's), CLAUDE CEILING (the loop, depositing back so the stratum boundary moves down — Law 1). Outputs are typed JSON with PER-FIELD provenance (floor|tree|claude + confidence); the chain's emitted artifact is the BUILD PACKET (intent / constraints / context / sub-problems / known-vs-novel / success criteria). The UI is /chart <something> — the chaining skill whose stages are SCHEMA-GATED HANDOFFS (each stage's prompt template-filled from the previous stage's validated file, so a skipped stage is a build error, not a lapse) — and /moreabout <something>, the learning door: a scoped expansion resolved from the upstream nexus's already-deposited state (a walk, never a re-run), whose every invocation is a labeled training signal written back to the tree.
why: Akien, verbatim, 2026-07-28: 'we intend that we can extract debug and grow these specific nexi, knowing we'll find more nexi and more details for each as we go. and the ui shall be /chart <something> --- learning from /moreabout <something>. why: improve the work claude is doing by giving him a more deterministic input.' Sharpened same day: 'to make your work better by giving you more deterministic input. why: so we can inspect and improve what you're getting.' INSPECTABILITY is the load-bearing half — CC's orientation today is invisible reasoning; as a packet on disk it can be inspected, diffed, improved. The trigger was MEASURED at home, not imported: the web-server carrier miss (CC-- 2026-07-28) is the premature-convergence failure — proximity to a plausible answer collapsed orient/constrain into pattern-match. And the skill-door facts (CC skips steps when the answer looks visible; plain instructions bypass skills; /skillname fires reliably) mean orientation-first cannot live as discipline — it lives behind the slash-door as physics. Work-measured evidence: moving the preamble into deterministic code + a pre-answered packet cut build tokens ~89% before caching.
traces_to: Law 1 — the resolver spent on the novel: the preamble compiled into floor+tree, Claude spent on hypothesize/build; every crossing deposits back; the per-nexus dial (fields filled by floor vs tree vs claude) is the compilation claim made measurable
Law 3 — confidence and provenance travel as DATA per field, never as hedging prose; the dial and the /moreabout frequency are measurements, not vibes

Law 4 — the schema gate at every handoff is the append-door pattern: a stage that cannot fill its schema fails loudly; template-filling from the prior stage's file makes step-skipping a build error (physics for CC's observed failure mode)
Law 6 — each nexus owns its tree and its exit schema; the chain composes them, opens no side door
Law 8 — (distant) shadow/champion promotion of a nexus (Claude -> Hex) needs N consecutive DOWNSTREAM behavioral matches — a proof a hollow (home-field self-scored) build couldn't pass

falsifier.proves_green: per stone: proof gate under the tester (netns seal) + validation persisted beside-code + committed. The standing live gate for every nexus: proven against the REAL operational agent (CC on real tasks) — for orient, the score is 'did downstream proceed without re-orienting'. The dial reports honestly: a nexus whose floor+tree fraction is not growing is not compiling.
falsifier.proves_red: RED on any of: a stage's output that fails the template-fill test (downstream needed an LLM re-read of upstream prose — the interface was shortened, not compiled); a floor answer crossing into WHAT-APPLIES (retrieval answers what EXISTS; only the loop above decides what applies — the harbor-exception drift was exactly a floor-match mis-applied); a packet field without provenance; /moreabout answered by re-running the upstream pass (fights parsimony directly); a monolithic packet-builder (nothing piecemeal to score, shadow, or promote); a nexus scored by its own tree's confidence (home-field manufactured resolution, measured at 0.8295 on the librarian); internal reasoning narrowed to match the output's tightness (loose process, tight output — separate concerns or parsimony squeezes the survey wide-ness that earns its keep).
falsifier.horizon: re-read when: orient v0 has run on enough real tasks to read its dial; when the librarian draws its first shared nexus (the unification's first measurement); when a second consumer wants the packet (the builder); when Hex is ready to shadow a nexus (the scoreboard stone); when /moreabout signals accumulate enough to adjust a parsimony threshold automatically (the tree compiling out a recurring correction).
